messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service: hosted-inference-prod (high). Incident PD-87321. Primary on-call: Maya (oncall-primary). Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-87321
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-87321 created by monitoring (latency spike > 500ms for 95th percentile). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Impact: elevated latency and 5% error rate.
Maya (oncall-primary): seeing the page, heading in now. can someone paste the error logs?
incidentbot: auto note: primary did not acknowledge within 90s. Escalating to secondary.
Dave (oncall-secondary): got the escalation. paging in parallel (phone ringing). on my way to keyboard, trying to access the cluster.
Tony (support): a few customers pinged support — multiple timeouts reported, some requests retried client-side. nothing legal/regulatory yet.
Dave (oncall-secondary): quick check — control plane reports spike in inference queue wait on gpu-pool-4. host pool shows 3/12 hosts with OOM restarts in last 10m. suspect model load/unload churn.
Lia (sre): can you paste the host logs? doing a quick grep on oom messages and kernel logs.
Dave (oncall-secondary): attaching snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T21:16:02Z] gpu-pool-4-node-07 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4321 (worker) score 123 or sacrifice child
[2026-03-15T21:16:03Z] inference-runtime: model load failed: insufficient memory for KV cache
[2026-03-15T21:17:10Z] autoscaler: attempted scale up +2 but AWS quota hit or slow provisioning
```
Maya (oncall-primary): I'm on VPN now. paging in — my phone was on DND, missed first page, sorry.
Kim (eng-manager): I got escalated. do we need a manager bridge? what's customer impact?
Dave (oncall-secondary): impact: elevated latency across several customers using long-context models. some requests in customer dashboards showing 504s; overall TPS degraded ~20%. Not service-wide outage but customer-visible degradation.
Tony (support): customer_abc reported multiple failures in last 12m, support ticket #S-1298. they asked for ETA.
Maya (oncall-primary): mitigation plan: 1) disable model auto-unload for hot models on gpu-pool-4 2) temporarily route new requests to gpu-pool-2 3) bump replica count for hot-model-v2. performing 1 now.
incidentbot: command accepted: disable auto-unload for model hot-model-v2 on gpu-pool-4.
Dave (oncall-secondary): observed immediate decrease in load after toggling auto-unload, but node churn still present. scaling attempt to +3 failed due to quota; requesting manual approval for temporary burst quota from infra.
Kim (eng-manager): approve temporary burst, lia pls reach out to cloud ops for quota increase and keep me posted.
Lia (sre): on it — opened cloud ticket CT-4421 and requested capacity for N+3. estimated response 10-15m. in meantime I'll cordon the worst nodes and redeploy runtime to clear memory fragmentation.
Maya (oncall-primary): redeploy commands executed: ```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod --selector=gpu-pool=gpu-pool-4
```
Dave (oncall-secondary): restart looks good on 8/12 pods, two pods keep failing the readiness probe (OOM loop). removing them from LB.
Tony (support): let customers_abc and def know: mitigation in progress, ETA ~15m, suggest they retry after 5m.
Maya (oncall-primary): adding a temporary routing rule to prefer gpu-pool-2 for long-context models. ```
PATCH /config/routing
{
  "service": "hosted-inference-prod",
  "rule": "if model==hot-model-v2 and context_length>1024 -> prefer gpu-pool-2"
}
```
incidentbot: routing rule applied. note: this will direct ~12% of traffic away from gpu-pool-4.
Dave (oncall-secondary): latency trending down now: 95th pctl from 820ms -> 320ms over last 5m. error rate down to 1.2%.
Maya (oncall-primary): leaving a note on PD: `temporary routing + disable auto-unload mitigated spike; follow-up: investigate OOM root cause and adjust quantization or KV allocation`
Kim (eng-manager): good triage. please start a post-incident ticket and assign owners: root cause analysis (Maya), infra quota follow-up (Lia), customer comms (Tony).
Tony (support): I'll push updates to affected customers and link PD + support ticket.
Dave (oncall-secondary): thumbs. Thanks everyone for the quick reroute and manual actions.
Tony (support): customers updated. marking support ticket S-1298 as waiting-on-engineering with link to PD.
Lia (sre): cloud ops responded — temporary capacity granted (N+2) while they process full quota increase. keeping CT-4421 open.
Maya (oncall-primary): closing thread here. will post postmortem doc link in #incidents when ready. :wave:
